blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Eight times seventeen times one hundred twenty-five.
Eight and one hundred twenty-five make one thousand, so let's put them together. The commutative property lets us swap the seventeen and the one hundred twenty-five.
The associative property lets us group the eight with the one hundred twenty-five.
Eight times one hundred twenty-five is one thousand.
One thousand times seventeen is seventeen thousand.
So the answer is seventeen thousand.
Watch out for these traps. If you add the one hundred twenty-five, you get two hundred sixty-one. If you add eight and one hundred twenty-five, you get two thousand two hundred sixty-one.
